messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"book_code":"4BAR","chapter":6,"verses":[{"chapter":6,"text":"1 After this, Abimelech went out of the city and prayed to the Lord.","verse":1},{"chapter":6,"text":"2 And an angel of the Lord came and took him by the right hand and brought him back to where Baruch was sitting, and he found him in a tomb.","verse":2},{"chapter":6,"text":"3 And when they saw each other, they both wept and kissed each other.","verse":3},{"chapter":6,"text":"4 But when Baruch looked up he saw with his own eyes the figs that were covered in Abimelech’s basket.","verse":4},{"chapter":6,"text":"5 And lifting his eyes to heaven, he prayed, saying:","verse":5}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
